title: Grammar — 100 Sentences: Parts of Speech & Sentence Types

cards.front:
[A] little boy walked beside the large dog.
What kind of word is [A]?
A. Subject Noun (SN)
B. Verb
C. Article
D. Adjective
cards.back:
C. Article
Why? A points to the noun boy.

cards.front:

C. Verb
D. Subject Noun (SN)

cards.front:

D. Period
cards.back:

cards.front:

cards.front:

A. Adverb
B. Article
C. Preposition

cards.front:

cards.front:

D. Verb
